Name: HEALING DRAUGHT
Main Effect: Drinking this draught restores 1d6 + Mind in Health.

Name: LOVE POTION
Main Effect:
When an entity drinks this potion, make a Mind roll against its Grit.

On a success, for 1 hour the drinker holds you as a trusted ally and is ready to do what it must to help you, so long as it does not put the drinker in harm.

Name: FLAME BURST FLASK
Main Effect:
Throw the flask at a point you can see within 9 meters (30 feet). It breaks on contact, and every entity within 3 meters (10 feet) takes 1d6 + Mind in Fire damage.

The flames stay for 3 turns. An entity that starts its turn in them takes the same again.

Name: POTION OF INSTINCT
Main Effect: Drinking this potion increases your Instinct by 2 for 1 hour.

Name: POTION OF MIND
Main Effect: Drinking this potion increases your Mind by 2 for 1 hour.
Came from: Novice 5 and 6, Intellect Potion and Wits Potion, folded

Name: POTION OF PHYSIQUE
Main Effect: Drinking this potion increases your Physique by 2 for 1 hour.

Name: GROWTH ELIXIR
Main Effect:
Drinking this elixir adds 2 meters (6 feet) to your height and massively increases your muscle mass for 1 hour.

While it lasts your Physique is increased by 5, your Movement Speed by 4 and your Defense by 2, and your Instinct is reduced by 5.
